notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware run is claimed. The upstream clone is neither imported nor installed, and the fake needs neither pybullet, gym nor numpy. The fake is a simplified pure Python stand-in for InvertedPendulumBulletEnv with placeholder masses and Euler integration; it was not compared with Bullet, and the sim backend (gym.make of the registered environment) was not run. Its differences are in the driver's fidelity gaps. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1, because the seed is stored for the next reset and makes no native call, and four G8.NO_UNIT for integer inputs and the action array the bridge derives (seed in reset, seed in seed, ticks, action.values). No G4 warning was reported. The bridge publishes an options object for reset, but the upstream reset takes no arguments, so a non-empty options object is refused by the fake. The device is simulated R0, so no limit is operator_required and there is no site-limits overlay. Only catalogue cap.world.* classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the last check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
